messages.content:
Select the shared shell layout in the markup:

```tsx
<section data-grid="shell" className={`data-table-wrapper ${className}`}>
```

The shared grid system should own this layout. Retain the component class and supplied className for their remaining responsibilities. Once the shell definition is verified, remove the duplicate display: grid and grid-template-rows declarations from the component rule; preserve unrelated declarations. Adding the attribute alone would leave two owners for the same layout.

Verify that grid.css is available, the shell selector applies, and the header/main/footer layout still behaves as intended. This change has not been applied or runtime-tested.

reason: Use the project shared shell grid as the layout owner instead of duplicating its definition in component CSS.
